P4/ESP-Claw final-audit note

The task-start read-only snapshot and the first post-task snapshot had identical
HEAD, status, and tracked diff. HEAD was:

3dae9be909d6c08002b4c341e2b818d544a3e80e

After the evidence ZIP was first packed, a final read-only audit found that the
four log files which had been staged at task start were now untracked. The Git
index metadata reports a new creation/write time of 2026-07-24 04:45:29/04:45:30
+08:00. HEAD did not move, reflog has no new HEAD operation, the log files still
exist with their original timestamps, and there is no tracked or cached diff.

This task executed no Git write command and did not attempt to restore the index,
because Git writes are explicitly forbidden. The final state is preserved in
p4_final_audit_state.txt. The earlier exact snapshots remain preserved as
p4_before_state.txt and p4_after_state.txt.

This is an external/concurrent repository-metadata change, not a P4 source or
working-file modification made by the Stage 7C implementation.
